name: FSQ WAA Remote Eval
description: Transport the complete WAA evaluator and fixed Dataset to a Windows Dev Box, install the exact configured FSQ source commit in a private venv, and publish native UI evaluation evidence.

variables.name: git-url
variables.description: FSQ source installed and executed on the remote Machine.

variables.name: git-branch
variables.description: Remote branch fetched before preparing an exact-commit venv.

variables.name: bootstrap-python
variables.description: Optional remote Python 3.11+ executable path. Otherwise discover Python on that Machine.

variables.name: edge-exe
variables.description: Optional remote msedge.exe path; standard installations are discovered.

variables.name: case-ids
variables.description: Original Case IDs, comma-separated. Empty selects the three supported settings tasks.

variables.name: expected-host
variables.description: Optional remote Windows hostname guard. Do not select local as the execution Machine.

stages.name: Deploy and evaluate on remote Windows
